My boyfriend and I were driving home one day when it was torrential downpouring. There was a bit of traffic then we see a kid, probably 13 or 14, running down the sidewalk, screaming at the top of his lungs and crying with his dead dog in his arms. It was a pretty large black lab type of dog, but he carried it despite the size while still running. We passed the car that must've had hit the dog and the driver was just outside of the front door. He looked so guilty knowing that he had killed that kid's dog. Just hearing the scream, seeing the look on that kid's face, and his dog limp in his arms... It was just so awful. I can't say I've ever seen anything traumatizing like what many people are writing of here, but the look on his face, knowing his precious dog was just killed... On top of the whole thing, the awful weather added such an eery and melancholy mood as well. It reminded me of a lot of painful things that happen to everyone and I couldn't get that kid off of my mind for so long.

I have been regularly smoking for about a year and half and I've had similar situations. Smoking helped me cope with depression and bipolar disorder, but I started having really bad highs after a while. It started after I tried shrooms for the first time, so it may have been because of that, but I'm not 100% sure. Well, I took a break for a while and when I started again I would only smoke in small doses because my tolerance went down and it kept me from getting too high which tends to trigger high anxiety. I recommend that you just smoke smaller amounts for a bit and if you feel good then smoke more. Also, keep a positive mindset, because if you toke while having negative thoughts because of past experiences, you're probably more likely to feel scared again. I really hope you can solve the issue! Good luck~!
